note: Alberta Parks campground on Gull Lake, ~17 km W of Lacombe off Hwy 12, next to Brewers Campground: three loops of open sites suited to large trailers and RVs, with its own beach, playgrounds and ball diamonds, and trails to Brewers Campground and the Ebeling Beach day use (Ripples Concession). Note (2025): boat launches closed due to low lake levels. --Claude
summary: Confirmed against the page and the shop list: 249 sites (27 unserviced $31, 149 power 15/30-amp $39, 73 power/water/sewer 30-amp $55), every one pull-through, 41-45 ft, Loops A-C; showers, flush toilets, tap water, sani-dump; season May 13 - Sep 8 (2026), reservable 90 days ahead. Added season, max length, facilities; fees unchanged. Phone and website flagged; not waterfront confirmed.
